entries.t: 怀卡托大学Terry Isson认为岩石风化实现碳移除的持久性存疑
entries.c: 零碳产业/物质循环/有机物（碳循环）/CCUS
entries.as: 怀卡托大学Terry Isson在Science发文指出增强岩石风化碳封存持久性存疑：钙镁离子向海洋输运中易形成次生碳酸钙矿物并释放CO2，亚马逊河口可截留67%镁离子。现有监测仅关注施用点忽略全路径损失，若计入采矿运输排放该技术甚至可能成为净排放源，呼吁碳市场暂缓为其发放信用。
entries.b:
5月21日，怀卡托大学Terry Isson等在Science发布观点称岩石风化去除大气CO₂后向水体迁移过程可能造成泄漏。增强岩石风化（增强碱度）技术通过向陆地或海洋施加钙、镁等富含阳离子的矿物，加速岩石溶解，将大气中的CO₂转化为溶解无机碳（主要为碳酸氢根和碳酸根），理论上可实现海洋长期储碳，同时缓解海洋酸化。该观点认为，释放出的钙、镁离子在从土壤、河流向海洋输运途中，极易通过吸附或沉淀形成次生矿物——包括碳酸钙（方解石、文石）和黏土矿物。当钙离子与碳酸氢根结合形成碳酸钙固体时，会发生逆反应——每生成一分子碳酸钙，就会释放一分子CO₂回到环境中。这意味着原本被固定的碳不仅未能长期封存，反而发生“泄漏”。
此外，现有监测与碳核算体系仅关注施用点（如土壤表层30厘米）的碱度变化，完全忽略了从陆地到河口、近海全路径中的离子损失。研究显示，亚马逊河口可截留高达67%的镁离子，类似现象也见于长江口。若计入采矿、研磨和运输的碳排放，增强碱度甚至可能成为净排放源。
作者呼吁，在全面量化全链条碳损失及生态风险（如重金属释放、粉尘危害）之前，碳市场不应盲目为该项技术发放减排信用。真正的持久固碳，必须经得起从陆地到海洋的全程检验。

entries.t: 通过有机盐驱动钠补充实现能量密度超180 Wh/kg的钠离子电池
entries.a: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/钠电池
entries.as: 钠离子电池研究取得突破性进展。针对P2型层状钠金属氧化物正极材料固有的大量钠离子缺失问题，研究团队提出有机盐驱动的钠补充策略，成功将钠离子电池能量密度提升至180 Wh/kg以上。该方法通过在正极材料合成过程中引入有机盐前驱体，实现钠位缺陷的有效补偿，显著改善循环稳定性与首圈库仑效率。这一成果缩小了钠离子电池与锂离子电池在能量密度上的差距，为大规模储能和低成本电动汽车应用提供了新路径。
kp: 能量密度[钠离子电池]: >180 Wh/kg
[补钠策略]: 四苯基硼酸钠补钠
[正极材料]: P2型层状钠金属氧化物

entries.t: [ASAP] 通过界面水分子重构热调控CO2活化路径实现安培级近单位法拉第效率
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.c: 零碳产业/物质循环/有机物（碳循环）/有机工业/电化学过程/CO2RR
entries.as: 该工作提出通过界面水结构的热调控来调控CO2电还原路径的突破性策略。电化学CO2还原制CO是碳利用技术的关键步骤，但高选择性难以长期维持。研究表明温度变化可重塑电极界面处水分子的排布结构，进而精确调控CO2活化中间体的生成路径，为提升CO选择性与能量效率提供了新思路。
kp: [调控机制]: 界面水重构热调控CO₂活化路径
entries.b: Electrochemical reduction of CO2 to CO is a key step in carbon utilization technologies, yet maintaining high CO selectivity under elevated temperatures relevant to industrial membrane-electrode-assembly (MEA) electrolyzers remains challenging due to the competing hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). Additionally, the temperature dependence of CO selectivity on Cu-based catalysts has remained largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that incorporating atomic In or Sn into Cu fundamentally reshapes the selectivity of Cu catalysts at elevated temperatures. Dilute alloy catalysts, In1Cu and Sn1Cu, achieve >95% FE of CO over a broad current-density window (0.1-1.1 A cm-2) at 60 °C in MEA electrolyzers, far exceeding their performance at ambient temperature. In situ attenuated total reflection surface-enhanced infrared absorption spectroscopy suggests that elevating temperature depletes interfacial water activity, which favors a shift in CO2 activation from a proton-coupled *COOH pathway toward an electron-driven *COO--associated pathway, while also suppressing HER and CO hydrogenation. In contrast, benchmark CO-selective catalysts such as Ag exhibit minimal temperature-induced changes in CO production at 20-60 °C. These findings identify temperature as an unavoidable yet previously underutilized operating parameter in MEA electrolyzers for high-rate, selective CO production on Cu-based catalysts.

entries.t: 大语言模型通过标准三方图灵测试
entries.a: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/文本模型
entries.as: 研究验证大语言模型通过标准三方图灵测试。图灵测试不仅是机器智能的衡量标准，也反映人类对机器的感知。实验表明先进LLM在模拟人类对话方面达到难以区分的程度，引发对人工智能身份认知、社会影响及AI能力边界的深层讨论。
entries.b: The Turing test has been widely discussed as a test of machine intelligence, but it also provides a measure of how humans distinguish other humans from machines. We evaluated 4 systems (ELIZA, GPT-4o, LLaMa-3.1-405B, and GPT-4.5) in two randomized, controlled, and preregistered Turing tests on independent populations. Participants had 5 min conversations simultaneously with another human participant and one of these systems before judging which conversational partner they thought was human. When prompted to adopt a humanlike persona, GPT-4.5 was judged to be the human 73% of the time: significantly more often than interrogators selected the real human participant. LLaMa-3.1, with the same prompt, was judged to be the human 56% of the time—not significantly more or less often than the humans it was being compared to. Without these prompts, however, the same models performed significantly worse (38% and 36%), and did not consistently outperform baseline models, ELIZA and GPT-4o (23% and 21%, respectively). A third study replicated these results in 15-min games: two PERSONA-prompted models achieved pass rates of 56% and 59%. The results constitute empirical evidence that artificial systems can pass a standard three-party Turing test. Interrogators’ reasoning focused more on stylistic and socio-emotional aspects of human behavior rather than more traditional notions of intelligence. The results have implications for debates about what kind of intelligence is exhibited by large language models, the social impacts these systems are likely to have, and the aspects of human behavior that people continue to see as unique.

entries.t: 用于体表边缘计算的大规模可拉伸神经形态电路
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI硬件层/芯片
entries.as: 研究团队开发了大规模可拉伸神经形态电路，用于体表边缘计算。该器件利用本征可拉伸电子材料构建，能够处理大量多模态传感数据并实现片上神经形态计算。与传统可穿戴设备将数据上传云端不同，该电路在采集端即可完成信息处理，大幅降低延迟和功耗。这一突破为可穿戴健康监测、软体机器人等需要实时本地智能处理的应用开辟了新路径。
kp: [柔性神经形态]: 可拉伸有机电化学晶体管边缘计算
[制造突破]: 可扩展制造解决柔性电路瓶颈
entries.b: Intrinsically stretchable electronics can be used to make wearable devices that collect large amounts of multimodal sensory data. This has led to a demand for enhanced near-sensor computing capabilities that can process such data. One potential solution is neuromorphic edge computing implemented using stretchable organic electrochemical transistors, but the lack of a scalable fabrication method for these transistors has limited the size and complexity of the systems. Here we report the fabrication of large-scale, intrinsically stretchable organic electrochemical transistor arrays with a density up to 10,000 transistors per square centimetre. The transistors exhibit good synaptic performance, including linear, precise conductance programming and good retention. The performance uniformity of the array enables the hardware implementation of a stretchable artificial neural network for processing health data, including heart attack risk assessment and kernel convolution for locating propagation wavefronts. We also explore the potential of implementing reinforcement learning algorithms on the neuromorphic circuits for use in soft robotics.

entries.t: ProteomeLM：蛋白质组规模语言模型实现蛋白质相互作用和基因功能的精准快速预测
entries.a: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/文本模型
entries.as: ProteomeLM是一种蛋白质组规模的蛋白质语言模型，能够快速、准确地预测蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）和基因功能。该模型在大规模蛋白质序列数据上预训练，学习到氨基酸序列中的深层语义表示，可将表征迁移至下游预测任务。相比传统实验方法，ProteomeLM大幅降低了PPI网络构建和功能注释的时间与成本，为药物靶点发现、疾病机制解析及合成生物学设计提供高效计算工具。
kp: [模型架构]: transformer蛋白质组级语言模型
[训练任务]: 全蛋白组上下文掩码嵌入重建
entries.b: Language models trained on biological sequences are advancing inference tasks from the scale of single proteins to that of genomic neighborhoods. Here, we introduce ProteomeLM, a transformer-based language model that uniquely operates on entire proteomes from species spanning the tree of life. ProteomeLM is trained to reconstruct masked protein embeddings using the whole proteomic context, yielding contextualized protein representations that reflect proteome-scale functional constraints. Notably, ProteomeLM’s attention coefficients encode protein–protein interactions (PPI), despite being trained without interaction labels. Furthermore, it enables interactome-wide PPI screening that is substantially more accurate, and orders of magnitude faster, than amino acid coevolution-based methods. We further develop ProteomeLM-PPI, a supervised model that combines ProteomeLM embeddings and attention coefficients to achieve state-of-the-art PPI prediction across benchmarks and species. Finally, we introduce ProteomeLM-Ess, a supervised gene essentiality predictor that generalizes across diverse taxa. Our results demonstrate the potential of proteome-scale language models for addressing function and interactions at the organism level.

entries.t: 中科院物理所开发出无液氦亚K强磁场扫描隧道显微镜
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 中科院物理所郇庆团队联合企业研制无液氦亚K强磁场扫描隧道显微镜，具备⁴He和³He两种制冷模式，最低电子温度420mK，温度稳定性±0.1mK，震动<1pm，兼容5T超导磁体。相比传统湿式STM，干式系统具备长期连续运行、可高温烘烤、兼容常规实验室等优势，成果发表于Review of Scientific Instruments。
entries.b:
5月21日，中科院物理所在官方公众号发文称，该所郇庆团队中科艾科米、北京飞斯科科技等企业，研制出新型无液氦亚K强磁场扫描隧道显微镜（STM）系统。文中称，传统“湿式”制冷受限于液氦储量及资源紧缺，难以满足长效科研需求。随氦气闭循环技术突破，无液氦的“干式”系统具有长效连续运行等优势，但其机械震动对高灵敏物理测量会造成影响。
此次开发的系统具备⁴He‑⁴He、⁴He‑³He两种制冷工作模式，系统基础温度（有效电子温度）分别可达894 mK（1.06 K）和420 mK（610 mK），并可兼容室温孔径超导磁体。可实现温度稳定性接近±0.1 mK，震动水平小于1pm，从低温到室温宽温区内连续变温成像，0-5T连续变场，并能够稳定运行数月。相较已有液氦杜瓦的湿式STM方案的低温维持时间有限、运行成本高、烘烤受限、所需安装空间较大等诸多问题，该系统展现着长期连续运行、宽温域可调、可高温烘烤、系统高度兼容常规实验室、无需地下安装空间与磁体配置灵活等诸多优势。相关研究成果也在Review of Scientific Instruments上发表。

entries.t: [ASAP] 瞬态三酰胺胺镎(V)–单(亚胺基)配合物：有效核电荷驱动的C–H激活和氢原子转移
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.as: 首次报道了超铀元素镎的瞬态单亚胺基配合物。镎(V)-单亚胺基配合物通过[NpIII(TrenTIPS)]与叠氮化物反应生成，伴随N2释放。有效核电荷驱动的C-H键活化和氢原子转移反应证明了该瞬态物种的反应活性，填补了锕系单亚胺基化学中镎元素的长期空白。
entries.b: Metal-mono(imido) linkages have been known for seven decades, and they are found in transition metal, main group, lanthanide, thorium, and uranium complexes. However, transuranium-mono(imido) complexes remain unknown in any scenario. Here, we present evidence for transient neptunium(V)-mono(imido) complexes. Treatment of [NpIII(TrenTIPS)] (1, TrenTIPS = {N(CH2CH2NSiPri3)3}3-) with N3R (R = SiMe3; 1-adamantyl, Ad) results in N2 evolution and dark purple solutions consistent with the formation of [NpV(TrenTIPS)(NR)] (3NpNR). However, solutions of 3NpNR rapidly turn orange, where for R = SiMe3 the isolated 1:1 products are [NpIV(TrenTIPS){N(H)SiMe3}] (4a) and [NpIV(TrenTIPS-2H){N(H)SiMe3}] (4b, TrenTIPS-2H = {N(CH2CH2NSiPri3)2(NCH2CH2NSiPri2C[Me]=CH2)}3-). The latter contains a dehydrogenated-Pri vinyl functionality accounting for the source of the two amido H atoms. The reaction for R = Ad proceeds similarly, but only [NpIV(TrenTIPS){N(H)Ad}] (5a) could be unequivocally confirmed, though its isolation suggests generality of the imido-to-amido functional group transformation. Complexes 4a/4b exhibit slow relaxation of their magnetization, adding to the small number of transuranium single ion magnets. Experimental and computational analysis suggests that the amido products are formed by C-H activation and two sequential hydrogen atom transfer reactions involving a three-step proton-coupled electron-transfer sequence of H• radical abstraction, electron transfer, then another H• radical abstraction step. In contrast to transient 3NpNR, the 5f2 uranium(IV)-imido complex [K(2.2.2-cryptand)][UIV(TrenTIPS)(NSiMe3)] (8UNSiMe3) is robust, even in boiling THF, suggesting the transience of 5f2 3NpNR is not due to the 5fn-count but the increased effective nuclear charge of neptunium vs uranium. This work highlights divergence of uranium- and neptunium-imido stabilities, emphasizing that the latter is an inherently challenging synthetic target.

entries.t: 利用消费级激光雷达通过运动诱导采样对隐藏物体成像
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 该研究提出一种利用消费级LiDAR设备（如手机、AR眼镜中的固态LiDAR）实现非视距成像的新方法。通过运动诱导采样，即设备移动过程中累积的多角度测量数据，重建被遮挡物体的三维轮廓。该技术突破了传统LiDAR仅能成像视距内目标的限制，有望应用于自动驾驶、机器人导航及增强现实等场景。
kp: [采样方法]: 运动诱导采样
entries.b: Light-detection and ranging (LiDAR) is being increasingly deployed for consumer imaging across handheld, wearable and robotic applications1,2,3,4. These sensors measure the time-of-flight of light at picosecond resolution, which could enable them to image objects hidden from their field of view. Although such non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging capabilities have been shown on research-grade LiDAR devices, they remain challenging to achieve on consumer devices due to poor signal quality resulting from low laser power, low spatial resolution, and object and camera motion. Here we propose a multi-frame fusion strategy to overcome these challenges and demonstrate NLOS imaging on consumer LiDAR. We introduce the motion-induced aperture sampling model to unify the effects of object shape, object motion and camera motion under a single measurement model. Using this model, we demonstrate several NLOS capabilities on a smartphone-grade LiDAR: (1) three-dimensional reconstruction; (2) single- and multi-object tracking; and (3) camera localization using hidden objects. Previously, NLOS imaging capabilities were restricted to bulky and expensive research-grade hardware that requires extensive set-up and calibration. Our results represent a shift towards plug-and-play NLOS imaging, where anyone can image hidden objects with off-the-shelf hardware (for less than US$100) and no additional set-up. We believe democratization of such capabilities will advance consumer applications of NLOS imaging.
